primary_sources.name: HTTP Dataset CSIC 2010
primary_sources.publisher: Information Security Institute (ISI), Consejo Superior de Investigaciones Científicas (CSIC - Spanish National Research Council), Madrid, Spain
primary_sources.traffic_characterization: Automated synthetic testbed traffic generated against experimental e-commerce application 'tienda1' using web crawlers and automated web vulnerability scanners (Paros proxy, Nessus); NOT captured real-world production network traffic from live human attackers
primary_sources.license_status: Custom Open Academic Research Use (Unspecified formal OSI / Creative Commons license)
primary_sources.license_terms_analysis: The dataset was directly released by CSIC researchers for academic and non-commercial research to benchmark web intrusion detection systems. It contains no formal open-source license grant (e.g. MIT, Apache, CC-BY).

citations.academic_paper: Torrano-Giménez, C., Pérez-Villegas, A., & Álvarez Marañón, G. (2010). An anomaly-based approach for intrusion detection in web traffic. Journal of Information Assurance and Security, 5(4), 446–454.
citations.dataset_reference: Torrano-Giménez, C., Pérez-Villegas, A., & Álvarez, G. (2010). HTTP Dataset CSIC 2010. Information Security Institute, Spanish National Research Council (CSIC). Available at: http://www.isi.csic.es/dataset/

primary_sources.name: OWASP ModSecurity Core Rule Set (CRS) Regression Test Cases
primary_sources.publisher: OWASP Foundation / OWASP Core Rule Set Project
primary_sources.traffic_characterization: Curated synthetic security regression test cases for Web Application Firewall (WAF) rule verification executed via go-ftw / ftw framework

citations.project_reference: OWASP Foundation. (2020–2024). OWASP ModSecurity Core Rule Set (CRS). GitHub repository: https://github.com/coreruleset/coreruleset.

usage_terms_and_redistribution_notice.local_evaluation_status: Fully permitted. Local execution, benchmark replication, and metric calculation within research and development repositories are fully authorized under academic research use and ASL 2.0.
usage_terms_and_redistribution_notice.redistribution_status: The derived evaluation subset (data/scenarios/external_benchmark_v1.json) is distributed within this research codebase for academic peer review and scientific reproducibility. Standalone commercial redistribution, resale, or sublicensing of the CSIC 2010 portion is restricted by the absence of an explicit commercial redistribution grant from CSIC.
usage_terms_and_redistribution_notice.benchmark_characterization: This benchmark is explicitly a CONSTRUCTED EVALUATION SUBSET using external automated testbed data (CSIC 2010) and security-rule regression test payloads (OWASP CRS). It does NOT represent captured live-production network traffic.
